protocol.backfill: If a cap cannot fill ten slots, use highest-ranked skipped products and record violations.
protocol.architecture_rule: Choose fewest sources whose paired 95% lower bounds against all more complex alternatives exceed -0.001 for Recall@10 and NDCG@10.
protocol.diversity_rule: Adopt the least restrictive tested cap only if pair diversity improves and both accuracy-difference 95% lower bounds exceed zero.
protocol.uncertainty: 2,000 paired user-bootstrap samples, seed 42. Development intervals conditional on fitted models; not adjusted for multiple comparisons or historical model selection.
